$comment: Rule data for the derived-point corpus categories (derived-point-in-sign / derived-point-in-house, #517). There is no source text for a Lot in a sign or a house, so the generator is given these sourced rules and asked to COMPOSE from them (owner decision, 2026-10-11); it is never asked to recall astrology. Every rule cites passage ids in docs/references/derived-points.references.json, and test/tools-corpus-gen-derived-points.test.ts fails if a cited id does not exist.

part-of-fortune.name: Part of Fortune
part-of-fortune.nature: the point of the body and of material fortune: how bodily life, livelihood and the crafts of the hands find their footing
part-of-fortune.judged_through: the sign it falls in, that sign's classical ruler, and the strength of its house

part-of-spirit.name: Part of Spirit
part-of-spirit.nature: the point of the mind and will: the soul, and action carried out through words, dealings, gifts and receipts
part-of-spirit.judged_through: the sign it falls in, that sign's classical ruler, and the strength of its house

ruler_means.$comment: What a classical ruler of the sign brings to the Part of FORTUNE (Ptolemy IV.2, Valens II.4). Sourced for Fortune only. For the Part of Spirit no source gives a per-planet reading, so the generator is told the ruler's general nature instead and that this is synthesis.

saturn.fortune: livelihood through land, building, farming and the sea; prosperity in the work Saturn apportions

jupiter.fortune: livelihood through office, governance, positions of trust or religious service; a fortunate start from youth

mars.fortune: livelihood through command, military or forceful enterprise

venus.fortune: livelihood through friends, gifts and women (including the dowry); renown and good things

mercury.fortune: livelihood through learning, the sciences and trade

sun.fortune: a luminary: its witness strengthens whatever the other rulers of the point promise, and on its own it names no particular means of livelihood

moon.fortune: a rise in stature, strongest when she stands in her own triplicity

house_classes.$comment: Valens II.17 and Lilly II.xxiii state the angular / succedent / cadent principle for the Part of FORTUNE. The same principle is applied to the Part of Spirit by analogy (owner decision), which the generator is told.

angular.strength: prominent and well supported: the point works openly and with weight

succedent.strength: of moderate prominence: it works steadily rather than conspicuously

cadent.strength: less outwardly supported: it works more quietly and asks for more effort to show

owner_examples.$comment: Illustrations of the intended register from the owner's decision, not sourced claims.
owner_examples.part-of-fortune: Fortune in the 2nd house: material gain through personal effort.
owner_examples.part-of-spirit: Spirit in the 10th house: vocation through public action.

synthesis_rules: Use only the facts supplied for the placement; add nothing from memory of astrological lore.
The point is a calculated sensitive point, not a planet: it has no will, motion or aspects of its own.
Describe a standing tendency, not an event: no ages, timing, sums of money, health outcomes, marriages or named professions.
Do not mention planets other than the sign's ruler where a ruler is supplied, and do not mention day or night births or any formula.
